SEN.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
The tool is a startup product built with the education ministry; no government body is stated to use it.
No public education system is stated to use the tool.

facts.fact: APS reports that Senegalese startup Andakia presented Allo Goor Gi, an AI platform answering pupils' questions by phone call in Wolof and French without internet, built with the Ministry of National Education and hosted on servers in Senegal, according to its designer.
